decisive_items: Serum complement-fixation IgG antibody titers of 1:512
Subarachnoid hemorrhage and mild cerebral edema
response.rationale: High serum complement-fixation IgG antibody titers and imaging findings consistent with neurocysticercosis

rejected.why: Negative bacterial culture and mycobacterial PCR testing reduce likelihood of meningitis
Lack of specific evidence and negative tests make cerebral malaria less probable
Negative HIV serology and lack of specific syphilis testing results reduce likelihood of neurosyphilis
Negative mycobacterial PCR testing reduces likelihood of tuberculous meningitis
Negative cerebral angiogram reduces likelihood of cerebral vasculitis
